The '''Waskiro colony''' was a colony settlement of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Waskiro/Legends|Waskiro]]. During the [[Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] an [[attack on Waskiro]] was launched by combat [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of an unknown make. The few survivors were unable to identify the attackers' allegiance when the Republic came to investigate why the colony had gone silent.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Fate of Waskiro}}</ref>
